Chapter 6315: Three-Headed Viper

Chapter 6315: Three-headed Viper

The chains prevented the colossal creatures from escaping. Nevertheless, its miasma ravaged the area.

“That’s Goldclad Ancestor’s three-headed viper!” Mu Hu and Senior Brother Gong recognized it.

Disciples nearby saw the monster and hurriedly left the peak, not daring to get close.

“Why is it enraged?” They wondered.

It had yellow scales of a withering affinity, giving an uncomfortable impression at first glance. The scales were uneven as if something had attached to them, looking like a dog infected with scabies.

It had a pair of wings with holes everywhere. This was its natural appearance upon birth, also wielding a corrosive power.

It had three unique heads. The one in the center shared the same color as the rest of its body with scabs. The left one was as white as snow, exuding a terrifying chilling aura. The right one was molten. The neck’s scales had lava oozing out from the gaps.

This creature was under the care of two emperors in Centurial Peak - Goldclad and Lostmetal, the stronger members of the twelve.

They resided in Lost Peak, one of the six main mountains in Imperial Domain. Normally, disciples didn’t dare to get close because the viper was terrifying. They didn’t wish to become meals for no reason.

“This thing can’t be tamed or domesticated, what’s the point of raising it?” Li Qiye frowned.

Huntblade and Alch-deer exchanged glances. The former smiled awkwardly and said: “Ancestor Goldclad and Lostmetal created a supreme grand dao from observing the forms of this viper, that’s why they brought it back and sealed it properly. It never caused trouble before.”

“Bam!” Meanwhile, there seemed to be a thin layer up in the sky. A monster lay down, pushing it closer to Desolate Frontier.

This thing was in Star Ocean. Despite the separate dimensions, the monster was just too strong and somehow reached the sky of Desolate Frontier.

Its roar caused regular disciples to tremble in horror. Desolate gods and emperors became alarmed.

However, no creature could escape the prison due to the progenitor’s supreme seal.

Nevertheless, the roar summoned all other beasts like a king’s decree. The three-headed viper was affected and tried to escape from the peak.

“Get down, beast!” Two emperors appeared in the air, releasing their imperial auras. The resulting gales swept weaker disciples off their feet.

One wore a golden robe, looking tall and mighty. He seemed to be made from gold, possessing immense durability and weight.

The other gave the impression of something faulty. He had a metallic shimmer that was peeling away, corroding the sky around him. Pieces started falling off.

They summoned their stately anima trees, filling Desolate Frontier to the brim.

“The ancestors are here!” Disciples heaved a sigh of relief, believing in the duo.

“Clank!” They grabbed the iron chains and pulled the viper down.

“Raa!” It remained enraged, not listening to its masters.

Its right head opened its mouth, spewing out a torrent of lava. Rivers of lava coursed for thousands of miles, filling up the mountain range.

“Ahh!” Many disciples met an unfortunate demise.

“Damn!” Huntblade and Alch-deer leaped into the air, soaring toward Lost Peak.

“Retreat!” They ordered an evacuation. Other emperors and desolate gods joined the fray.

“How dare you?!” Goldclad and Lostmetal became furious and attacked.

The viper’s center head spewed out the yellow miasma toward Goldclad, corroding dao powers and laws.

He roared and mustered the power of a dark sun to burn the miasma.

The left head attacked at the same time, sending a chilling beam freezing time and space along the way. It could freeze the sun upon contact.
